note: Empyema is named directly in the clinical-indication list as an infection treated by penicillin G.

note: Bone and joint infections are an explicitly listed treatment indication; the footnote on limited study numbers does not negate it.

quote: For relief of the signs and symptoms of juvenile rheumatoid arthritis
note: Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis is the standard older synonym for juvenile idiopathic arthritis, and relief of a disease's signs and symptoms counts as management of the disease.

quote: because of a history of coronary artery disease, stroke, peripheral vascular disease, or diabetes that is accompanied by at least one other cardiovascular risk factor
note: Diabetes appears only as a risk-factor population for the cardiovascular-event reduction indication (and in contraindications); ramipril is not indicated to treat diabetes.

quote: Treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism (HPT) in adult patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) on maintenance dialysis therapy.
note: End-stage renal disease is the background population; the thing treated is secondary hyperparathyroidism.

quote: Doxycycline is indicated in the treatment of trachoma, although the infectious agent is not always eliminated
note: Trachoma is named directly as a treatment indication under ophthalmic infections.

quote: for the treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer
note: The label covers early and advanced/metastatic HR-positive HER2-negative breast cancer; 'breast cancer' is a near parent that still essentially describes what is indicated, not a whole organ-system class.

quote: indicated to decrease the incidence of infection, as manifested by febrile neutropenia, in adult patients with non-myeloid malignancies receiving myelosuppressive anti-cancer drugs
note: Febrile neutropenia is the outcome the drug is indicated to prevent (reduce incidence of); malignancy/chemotherapy is the setting, FN is the target.

quote: SYNAREL is indicated for treatment of central precocious puberty (CPP) (gonadotropin-dependent precocious puberty) in children of both sexes.
note: Central precocious puberty is named verbatim as the treatment indication.

quote: Treatment of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and in men at increased risk of fracture
note: EMA text names osteoporosis directly as the treated condition.

quote: monotherapy for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutations who have metastatic adenocarcinoma of the pancreas
note: Metastatic BRCA-mutated adenocarcinoma of the pancreas is a subtype of pancreatic adenocarcinoma and is a treatment (maintenance) indication.

quote: indicated for the management of hypoglycemia due to hyperinsulinism associated with the following conditions: ... Inoperable islet cell adenoma or carcinoma
note: Diazoxide treats the hypoglycemia (manifestation) caused by islet cell tumours; the pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasm itself is the underlying condition, not what the drug treats.
The supplied label indicates only relapsed/refractory CLL/SLL; follicular lymphoma is not mentioned anywhere in the text.

quote: SYMPROIC is indicated for the treatment of opioid-induced constipation (OIC) in adult patients with chronic non-cancer pain
note: Opioid-induced constipation is named verbatim as the treatment indication in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: indicated for the treatment of acute manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar disorder, with or without psychotic features
note: Manic/mixed episodes are a core manifestation of bipolar disorder and treating them is treating the disorder, analogous to the rubric's osteoarthritis-pain example; the pregnancy limitation is population-specific, not a negation.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring mesenchymal-epithelial transition ( MET ) exon 14 skipping alterations
note: METex14-altered metastatic NSCLC is a subtype of non-small cell lung carcinoma and is the treatment indication.

quote: Diphtheria: Infections due to Corynebacterium diphtheriae , as an adjunct to antitoxin, to prevent establishment of carriers and to eradicate the organism in carriers.
note: Diphtheria is listed as an indication (adjunctive to antitoxin), and adjunctive indications count per the rubric.

quote: for the treatment of edema associated with congestive heart failure, cirrhosis of the liver, and renal disease, including the nephrotic syndrome
note: Furosemide is indicated to treat edema, a manifestation, with nephrotic syndrome named only as the underlying condition causing it, parallel to the rubric's 'nasal congestion due to common cold' example.

quote: including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, high grade B-cell lymphoma
note: Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma is a named item in the list of indicated large B-cell lymphomas in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: indicated in combination with other antiretroviral medicinal products for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV 1) infection
note: HIV-1 infection is named verbatim as the treatment indication; combination with other antiretrovirals is a combination-therapy indication, which counts.
The supplied EMA text covers only prevention of skeletal-related events in bone-involving malignancies and giant cell tumour of bone; osteoporosis of any kind is not mentioned.

quote: Acute gouty arthritis Indomethacin suppository is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug indicated for: Acute gouty arthritis ( 1 )
note: Acute gouty arthritis is the acute form of gout and is listed as an indication on several labels; the extended-release 'not recommended' statement is formulation-specific and the texts are a union.

quote: Useful in the management of pruritus due to allergic conditions such as chronic urticaria and atopic and contact dermatoses, and in histamine-mediated pruritus.
note: The label indicates hydroxyzine for the pruritus (symptom) due to chronic urticaria and for the emotional overlay of such allergic conditions, not for treating the urticaria itself.

quote: KALYDECO is indicated for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients aged 1 month and older who have at least one mutation in the CFTR gene
note: Cystic fibrosis is named verbatim as the treatment indication on single-ingredient Kalydeco labels; the genotype restriction narrows the population, not the disease.

quote: Botulism (adjunctive therapy to antitoxin), gas gangrene, and tetanus (adjunctive therapy to human tetanus immune globulin) Clostridium species
note: Gas gangrene is a named item in the clinical-indication list for penicillin G against Clostridium species.

quote: long-term, once-daily maintenance bronchodilator treatment of airflow obstruction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
note: Maintenance bronchodilator treatment of COPD airflow obstruction is treatment of COPD itself on the single-ingredient Striverdi label; the acute-exacerbation limitation does not negate the maintenance indication.

quote: TYMLOS is indicated for the treatment of postmenopausal women with osteoporosis at high risk for fracture
note: Osteoporosis is named directly as the treated condition in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: Use Aids in the prevention of dental cavities
note: The only supplied indication is prevention of dental cavities; muscle weakness is not mentioned anywhere.

quote: for the treatment of signs and symptoms of osteoarthritis of the joints, and of acute and chronic pain in muscles and joints associated with muscle soreness, strains, sprains, arthritis
note: Osteoarthritis of joints and arthritis pain are indicated; 'arthritic joint disease' is a near parent that essentially describes what the label covers rather than a whole organ-system class.

quote: temporarily relieves nasal decongestion due to: common cold hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies (allergic rhinitis)
note: Oxymetazoline relieves nasal congestion (the symptom) due to allergic rhinitis, the exact pattern the rubric gives as FP2; the drug does not treat the allergic rhinitis itself.

quote: The treatment of paediatric patients (age 1 to <18 years) with relapsed or refractory systemic anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL)
note: ALK-positive systemic ALCL is a subtype of anaplastic large cell lymphoma and is a named treatment indication in the EMA text.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with Staphylococcus aureus bloodstream infection (bacteremia) (SAB), including those with right-sided infective endocarditis
note: Right-sided S. aureus infective endocarditis is explicitly included within the treated infection, so bacterial endocarditis (as a subtype) is a treatment target rather than merely a background condition.

quote: Oxazepam capsules are indicated for the management of anxiety disorders or for the short-term relief of the symptoms of anxiety.
note: Anxiety disorders and symptoms of anxiety are named directly as the indication.

quote: persistently elevated serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels and histological evidence of active liver inflammation and / or fibrosis
note: Fibrosis appears only as a histological eligibility criterion defining the hepatitis B population; the treated condition is chronic hepatitis B, not liver fibrosis.

quote: Ilaris is indicated for the treatment of active Still's disease including adult-onset Still's disease (AOSD) and systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (SJIA)
note: Adult-onset Still's disease is named verbatim as a treatment indication.

quote: Uses For temporary relief of temporary water retention bloat swelling full feeling fatigue minor aches and pains associated with the premenstrual and menstrual periods.
note: The supplied text is a jumble of unrelated products (salicylate rubs, salicylic acid acne/wart products, Choline C-11 PET agent); the one 'fatigue' mention is in an unidentified menstrual-relief OTC product that cannot be attributed to choline, so the text is too fragmentary to decide.

quote: indicated for the treatment of OAB in adult patients with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency, and urinary frequency
note: Urge urinary incontinence is named as a defining symptom of the overactive bladder that mirabegron treats; OAB is a symptom complex, so treating it is managing urge incontinence rather than a population-only mention.
